cases.actual: Authenticated Header language switch changed the page business text Users↔用户 and Dashboard↔仪表盘; both English and restored Chinese survived hard reload.

All 12 current Sidebar menu links were clicked and reloaded to their actual route; every route had main UI ready, zero alert, and corresponding actual GET 200. The existing Application link route ID matched the live application list item; its detail GET returned 200 with matching response ID. Clicking its Manage Artifacts link reached /artifacts with GET 200; direct /artifacts navigation also returned 200.

On a fresh unauthenticated sign-in page, switching to English changed username/password business labels; hard reload kept English. Restoring Chinese changed labels back; another hard reload kept Chinese, with no auth token and no API writes.

One actual invalid-credentials POST was paused for 161 ms. The submit button was disabled with spinner while pending; double-click/Enter produced no second POST. The one request reached the server and returned 401; no token was stored and the button re-enabled.

Clicked Dashboard Application Status View All and reloaded /applications with actual GET 200; clicked the real dashboard application link, whose route ID matched the API list ID and detail response ID.

Recent Executions View All works; visible Execution anchors bind to the real API. One live Task-name link resolved to matching Execution detail 200. Historical rows with deleted Tasks display the unknownTask label inside an Execution-detail anchor; their Task GET is 404 but the Execution link remains valid.
Compared Dashboard node/execution/application-health/sync aggregates to same-time GET API-derived aggregates; see timestamped per-field comparisons.

A true primary GET /api/nodes failure on hard reload produced ErrorState/Retry; clicking the real Retry restored the page. Supplemental exact GET /api/applications/{id}/state failure was caught per application and rendered Unknown with no global alert/Retry; after a real reload the same path returned 200. Root review is needed for the canonical “any Dashboard API” boundary.
remaining_dimensions: Root review whether per-application state GET is covered by canonical any-API Error/Retry requirement; it renders Unknown without global Error/Retry.
